_comment: GENERATED by scripts/dune-base-setup.mjs — maps each file under dune/base-chain/ to its Dune query id. /api/cron/dune-refresh imports dependentQueryIds to know what to re-run daily. That list is only the queries WITH A PANEL on the dashboard: the files in RETIRED (13_by_service, 14_by_contract, 15_by_rail) are hidden on Dune (is_temp) and appear in `queries` below but never in dependentQueryIds, because running a query with no panel spends credits updating something nobody can see. Safe to hand-edit only when the queries were created manually on dune.com (free-plan fallback).
